result.summary: The page is largely well-formed. The main visible defect is a nonsensical discount badge showing '–0%' on the pizza restaurant card, which indicates a data or formatting bug.

issues.description: The pizza card in the 'Popular right now' section displays a discount badge reading '–0%'. A 0% discount is meaningless to users and suggests a data/formatting error where the badge is rendered even when no discount exists.
issues.suggestion: Hide the discount badge when the discount value is 0 (or missing), or ensure the correct discount percentage is passed to the badge component.
